source.access: Entwine Point Tiles, public usgs-lidar-public bucket (AWS Open Data), anonymous HTTPS, octree depth <= 10
source.flightDatesNote: FGDC metadata (begdate/enddate) of the delivery tile at the Evanston test area, read in the Phase 5B pilot. The tile metadata of the other areas (Lakeview, Wilmette, Winnetka, Kenilworth) was not read; same delivery, so the same flight window is assumed (unverified for those tiles).
source.points: vendor building class (6) at least 2 m above a 5 m ground grid (classification) / 1 m (heights); about 4 points per m2 of roof

header.licenceNote: AWS Open Data registry lists the dataset as US Government Public Domain; the USGS copyright page itself was blocked (403) in the pilot, so the wording is unverified at the source. Acknowledgement of the originating agencies is requested in derived products (FGDC useconst).

footprints.note: closed building ways and building multipolygons whose centroid is inside the area; keys are OSM refs (way/<id>, relation/<id>); plus the Overture buildings the engine adds (no OpenStreetMap source, centroid in the area and outside every OSM building or part), keyed by the engine's ref: overture/<the full GERS id, 32 lowercase hex digits> (Sources/WorldMap/OvertureSource.swift OSMRef.init(overtureID:))

complexRule.summary: 2.0 complex rule: touching planes of one slope merged, sloped planes under minorShare of the roof ignored (dormers, porches, chimneys), mixed flat/sloped from a flat share of mixedMinShare, no-opposite-pair needs noPairMinPlanes major planes; fitted on tuning sets, checked on a frozen NAIP hand-labelled test set (handCheck)

roofAccuracy.what: forms hand-labelled from NAIP 0.3 m imagery (roofs the 1.0 classifier had classified, stable seeded sample of about 50 per area, labels frozen before the rule changed); accuracy = share of labelled roofs whose lidar form equals the hand label, roofs the labeller could not read excluded
roofAccuracy.thisArea: not hand-checked: no NAIP sample was labelled here; the rule was checked on evanston-south and lakeview-sheil-park (pooled below)

handCheck.pilotCheck: 30 South Evanston roofs (houses and garages), labelled from the lidar points themselves, 1.0 rules: simple form 26 of 30, four classes 24 of 30 (docs section 4)
handCheck.mansard: UNVALIDATED. The mansard rule (steep planes round a flat or low top) is unchanged from 1.0 and was set on a single flagged roof (a truncated hip, not a classic mansard); no independent mansard sample exists, so its precision and recall are unknown
handCheck.scope: hand-labelled areas: South Evanston (houses, garages) and Lakeview (flat-roofed rows and courtyard buildings); the suburban areas Wilmette, Winnetka and Kenilworth were not hand-checked

header.pitchClasses: flat < 10 deg; low 10 to < 25; medium 25 to 40; steep > 40 (pitchDeg = dominant plane slope)

fields.topM: roof top above ground, m (95th percentile of building points, ground = median class-2 ring 3 to 8 m around the footprint)
fields.eaveM: eave height above ground, m (15th percentile of points within 0.5 to 2 m of the footprint edge); null when too few points
fields.pitchDeg: slope of the dominant plane, degrees; mansard = mean slope of the steep lower planes
fields.form: flat / gable / hip / mansard / complex (mansard is UNVALIDATED: rule unchanged since 1.0, no independent mansard sample)
fields.points: building-class lidar points inside the footprint eroded by 0.75 m
fields.confidence: heuristic 0-1 score (point cover, density, plane coverage, form factor); not a probability
